title: flat_kv2 neg_sm cap-refill narrowing — per-task SM(t,kv0)-head whole-buffer fill (512B/2 repeats) narrowed to the contiguous prv region (256B/1 repeat)
status: REJECTED — measured +0.75% (R4) / +1.15% (c7), both below the preregistered 3% bar (distributions overlapping); precision Gate 0 was 11/11 bit-identical, flag protocol stable. gqa.py NOT touched by this arm (P1 adoption is the only iter7 edit). Variant + data retained.

mechanism.target: _gqa_kernel_prefill_g2stack_flat_kv2 emit_sm ONLY (the iter5-adopted kernel; kv1 flat / g2stack / decode / per-head / aux kernels NOT touched)
mechanism.edit: neg_sm slot layout remapped h*2+cur -> cur*2+h INSIDE flat_kv2 (bijective; all 7 cur refs + 2 prv refs in emit_sm remapped through the same map; no other kernel touches this buffer) so the prv slots at first_kv (kvpar==0) form the CONTIGUOUS region [2:4]; the per-task cap refill narrows from T.tile.fill(neg_sm) ([4,half,1] fp32 = 512B = 2 vector repeats) to T.tile.fill(neg_sm[(1-kvpar)*2 : (1-kvpar)*2+2, :, :]) ([2,half,1] = 256B = 1 repeat, still ONE instruction). cur-slot cap fill was a dead store (reduce_max is dest-only and runs before the slot's first read in the same beat — c2_design_iter5.md B.4-3/B.5-3 value-equivalence argument).
mechanism.nan_discipline: the prv cap refill itself is NEVER removed (iter2 NaN-leak lesson: a previous task's NaN/-Inf running max must not cross the task boundary); the per-task acc_o/sumexp fills in emit_ao are UNCHANGED (generator audit asserts both fill lines survive verbatim); the one-shot init whole-buffer fill is UNCHANGED; special-value propagation through the rescale chain is semantically identical to shipped.
mechanism.flag_protocol: NOT touched (generator audit: every set/wait flag line byte-identical to shipped) — no wait-id migration expected; telemetry recorded anyway per discipline #2, any unexpected migration reported as-is.
mechanism.variant_generation: perf_tuning/gen_variant_iter7_p5.py — programmatic extraction of gqa.py lines 3456-4027 (md5-pinned bd470e07..., boundary + edit-site asserts) + minimal line-scoped edits + static re-audit (remap census 7+2, fills census, flag-line identity, geometry identity, diff-hunk cap) + unified diff artifact diff_iter7_p5.txt (3 hunks).
mechanism.model_prediction: iter6 P5 card: vec busy 2.35->~2.28us/u, R4/c7 main -1..-2% (LOW expected value — below the 3% bar; honestly measured, goalposts NOT moved)

disposition.rollback_reason: improvement below the preregistered 3% threshold on both judgement shapes (goalposts not moved); no gqa.py change was made for this arm, so no rollback action was needed
disposition.post_mortem: the +0.18us/kv flat-form vec overhead attributed in iter5 to (cap refill + AO-head fills + FIN cadence) is dominated by the AO-head acc_o fill (16KB/task, NaN-discipline protected, NOT removable) and FIN cadence — the neg_sm refill is 512B->256B (2->1 vector repeat) per task, whose measured wall effect (~0.75-1.15%) sits at the noise floor. vec-busy micro-ops of this class are calibrated as NOT worth further iteration (probe report §4.4).
